subject.title: [Bug]: Windows Scheduled Task gateway restart/health becomes inconsistent after ready

question: Should maintainers keep this broad issue open until live Windows Scheduled Task proof covers `/Run` failure recovery and post-ready HTTP reachability, or narrow the remaining work to linked subset issues after their fixes land?
rationale: Current main has partial fixes, but the issue's full combined Windows behavior is not live-proven fixed and the remaining work spans overlapping open items.

options.title: Keep broad tracker open
options.body: Use this issue as the canonical live-proof target until one coordinated Windows Scheduled Task validation covers restart, fallback, listener ownership, cron recovery, and post-ready health.

options.title: Split to narrower issues
options.body: Close or retitle this only after maintainers confirm https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/90158 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/91144 own all remaining behavior.

recommendation.title: Keep broad tracker open
recommendation.body: Use this issue as the canonical live-proof target until one coordinated Windows Scheduled Task validation covers restart, fallback, listener ownership, cron recovery, and post-ready health.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the current assignee and has recent merged history in the related restart-health path.
